title: unified-rollouts-probing-staged-shadow-ab-autorollback-enhancements
author: Priya Desai
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for multi-stage rollouts (canary, A/B, staged shadow) and make automated rollback decisions more robust for production inference workloads. This PR implements probing-based staged shadowing, extends metric-matching for A/B/canary comparisons, and tightens automated rollback triggers with stability guards. The goal is to reduce false-positive rollbacks during transient noise and to provide clearer signals for operators during progressive rollouts.

What changed: consolidated the rollout controller logic, added a probing stage to shadow traffic (configurable probes/queries), implemented multi-metric matching with weighted scoring for canary vs baseline comparisons, and introduced stability guard windows and minimum sample thresholds before auto-rollback triggers. Also added per-rollout observability: rollout-specific dashboards, additional Prometheus metrics (rollout_probe_latency_bucket, rollout_metric_score, rollout_stability_window_failures), and e2e + integration tests that simulate transient spikes and gradual regressions.

Key features: 1) Probing staged shadow: send configurable probe queries to candidate model prior to full shadowing; probe results influence readiness. 2) Multi-metric weighted matching: supports combining latency, p50/p95, token-error-rate (regression detector), and quality eval delta into a single score. 3) Stability guards: minimum sample windows, grace period, and smoothing to avoid reacting to short-lived noise. 4) Safe auto-rollback: rollbacks only occur when weighted score crosses threshold for a sustained window or when multiple independent metrics fail. 5) Feature-flagged rollout: operator can enable staged probing and tightened rollback on a per-rollout basis.

Checklist: - [x] Controller and runtime integration for staged shadow probes - [x] Metric aggregation and scoring engine - [x] Observability: dashboards and new metrics + tracing hooks - [x] Unit tests for scoring and guards - [x] Integration and e2e tests simulating canary regressions - [x] Docs/console UI updates for rollout options - [x] Backwards-compatible: new fields are additive and behind flags

Testing & rollout plan: validated locally with perf-canary harness and ran e2e against toy service; integration tests exercise rollback logic under noisy and persistent regression scenarios. Plan to enable feature flag for internal Canary environment for 2 weeks, watch rollout_metric_score and stability windows, then gradually enable for select customers.

Related: linked to ENG-4928 (staged shadow probing) and ENG-5012 (robust auto-rollback).

review_comments: Ethan Morgan: Please ensure scoring weights are stable by default; suggest defaults that prioritize latency and token-error-rate (TER) over p95 in noisy workloads.
Priya Desai (author): Addressed in scoring.go, added default weight set in config with notes in docs (see commit b4e7f9a).
Lina Chen: Can we get more visibility into the probe queries used? Need to ensure probes are representative but safe for production data.

release_notes:
- Added staged shadow probing for safe model onboarding.
- Introduced weighted multi-metric scoring for canary/A-B comparisons.
- Stability guards to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks.
- New observability metrics and Grafana dashboard for rollout health.
notes: This change is behind feature flags (staged_shadow, strict_rollback) and is backwards compatible. Operators should tune weights and thresholds per workload; recommended defaults are included. Monitor rollout_metric_score and rollout_stability_window_failures when enabling in production.
